install_config_module: install a module-level config as a ConfigModule with attribute-based access
patch_config_values: patch config values temporarily using config.patch as a context manager or decorator
save_config_to_bytes: save the current config state to a pickled bytes blob for later restoration
load_config_from_bytes: load and restore a prior config state from a pickled bytes blob or dict
get_config_hash: get an MD5 hash of the non-compile-ignored config values for change detection
